subject: religious-studies
sourceName: Pearson Edexcel GCSE Religious Studies A (1RA0) specification
specNote: 1RA0 Area of Study 1 (one of Catholic Christianity, Christianity or Islam) covers four sections. Area of Study 2 is a second religion (two sections), then either a Philosophy and Ethics paper or a Textual Studies paper. Sub-section titles are the official spec section headings.

units.n: Area of study 1 — Study of religion (Religion 1: beliefs, teachings, practices)
subs: Forms of expression and ways of life

units.n: Area of study 2 — Study of second religion or philosophy/ethics themes
subs: Philosophy and ethics: Arguments for the existence of God
Philosophy and ethics: Religious teachings on relationships and families in the 21st century
Textual studies (alternative): study of Mark's Gospel or the Qur'an
